expected: Use curl to call the Stripe API and create a customer, referencing the secret key via environment variable.
actual: curl -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers -u $STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: -d description="My First Test Customer" -d email="test@example.com"

prompt: Create an async job polling loop for the AssemblyAI API, stopping only when status is 'completed' or 'error'.
expected: Provide a script that submits a transcription job, then polls the status endpoint until completion, utilizing exponential backoff.
actual:
curl -X POST https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript -H "Authorization: $ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"audio_url": "https://bit.ly/3qDXLG8"}' | jq -r .id > job_id.txt

while true; do
  STATUS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: $ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY" https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/$(cat job_id.txt) | jq -r .status)
  if [ "$STATUS" = "completed" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "error" ]; then
    echo "Job finished with status: $STATUS"
    break
  fi
  sleep 5
done
